name: Neck Stretch
instructions: Gently tilt your head side to side and hold each stretch for 15 seconds.

name: Shoulder Rolls
instructions: Roll your shoulders backward 10 times, then forward 10 times.

name: Air Squats
instructions: Do 10–15 controlled squats, keeping chest up and weight in heels.

name: Calf Raises
instructions: Rise up on your toes and slowly lower. Repeat 20 times.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a forearm plank position, keeping back straight.

name: Posture Reset
instructions: Stand up tall, roll shoulders back, and take three deep breaths.

name: Eye 20-20-20
instructions: Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
